scope: Every module the latest Logos Basecamp release makes available: bundled in the app, or installable from its default catalog.

evm-wallet.title: EVM wallet
evm-wallet.summary: Ethereum/EVM accounts, signing, fees, RPC, tokens, swaps — one keystore, one tx sender, human approval in a signer UI.

monero-wallet.title: Monero wallet
monero-wallet.summary: wallet2 (monero_c) in-process, a backend coordinator, remote or in-process monerod.

blockchain-lez.title: Blockchain & LEZ
blockchain-lez.summary: Logos blockchain node, the Logos Execution Zone (LEZ) client/wallet, indexer, explorer and AMM.

messaging.title: Messaging
messaging.summary: Delivery (Waku-style) node, e2e chat, libp2p, and RLN membership/proofs.

storage.title: Storage
storage.summary: Logos Storage node: upload, download, manifests.

platform.title: Platform
platform.summary: What Basecamp ships itself: package manager & downloader, capability (permissions), module lifecycle state, metrics, accounts.

methods.summary: Add a contact, or rename one already there — an UPSERT, because a user who saves an address they already have meant to name it.

methods.summary: Native and token balances for `address` on every enabled chain in the device scope.

methods.name: get_history
methods.summary: Transactions `tx_sender_module` broadcast for `address` on every chain in the current device scope, newest first — this wallet's own sends and any other app's calls from the same account.

methods.name: prepare_send
methods.summary: Quote a send without doing anything: resolves the token, checks an ERC-20 balance here, and has `tx_sender_module` price the fee, check the ether and read the nonce.

methods.name: send
methods.summary: Ask a human to approve a send.

methods.name: send_status
methods.summary: Advance a pending send and report where it got to.

methods.name: cancel_send
methods.summary: Withdraw a send that has not been approved yet, releasing its reserved nonce.

methods.name: refresh_tx_status
methods.summary: Re-read one recorded transaction's receipt on ITS OWN chain and update the stored status.

methods.name: get_tx_details
methods.summary: The transaction- and block-level fields a RECEIPT does not carry, for one recorded transaction on ITS OWN chain.

methods.name: refresh_pending
methods.summary: Poll receipts for this address's still-pending transactions, on each row's OWN chain, and update their stored status.

events.name: balances_updated
events.summary: A balance may have moved: a transaction this wallet is tracking settled.

events.name: tx_status_changed
events.summary: Relayed from `tx_sender_module`: a recorded transaction took a hash or settled.

events.name: send_status_changed
events.summary: Relayed from `tx_sender_module`: a pending send changed state.

events.name: accounts_changed
events.summary: The keystore's accounts moved — the set itself, or the names they are shown under.

events.name: tokens_changed
events.summary: The set of tokens OFFERED on `chain_id` moved.

events.name: history_changed
events.summary: Relayed from `tx_sender_module`: a recorded row for `address` appeared or changed with no hash for `tx_status_changed` to name.

events.name: networks_changed
events.summary: What `eth_rpc_module` reports for one chain moved — its endpoint, its transport, or its verified-proxy mode.
